explanation: At D1 and D2 the value is almost always 9-10, sagging to 7-8 at D1 right after an unrewarded trial and to 5-8 in long rewarded a1 streaks late in the episode (after trial 85). At GO it varies most: about 6-8 in the first ~30 trials of an episode, 4-6 right after an unrewarded trial later on, and 0-2 during later streaks of rewarded trials (a1 streaks are lowest, often 0).
